title: Low-Rank Ternary Adaptation for Fine-Tuning Transformers
abstract: arXiv:2608.24469v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Ternary transformers offer extreme memory and compute efficiency, but existing low-bit LoRA-based methods cannot directly fine-tune ternary weights. Current approaches either require dequantization, restoring low-bit base weights to higher precision to merge with adaptation weight, or update only quantization parameters, preventing a merged model that remains ternary. We propose ternary multiplicative adaptation, which represents discrete updates of ternary weights such as sign flips or zeroing through a low-rank Kronecker factorization into two small ternary matrices applied element-wise to ternary weights. This design is parameter-efficient and expressive, preserves the ternary domain, and supports direct merging without dequantization. Experiments on six models across language and vision, including ternarized LLaMA-3 1B and 3B and a ternary ViT-B/16, demonstrate that our method recovers much of the performance lost to quantization a

translated_title: 用于微调Transformer的低秩三元适配
translated_abstract: 三元Transformer提供了极致的存储和计算效率，但现有的低比特LoRA类方法无法直接微调三元权重。当前方法要么需要反量化，将低比特基权重恢复为更高精度以合并适配权重，要么仅更新量化参数，从而无法得到保持三元状态的合并模型。我们提出三元乘法适配，该方法通过将三元权重的离散更新（如符号翻转或置零）表示为两个小型三元矩阵的低秩Kronecker分解，并逐元素应用于三元权重。这种设计参数高效且表达力强，保持了三元域，并支持无需反量化的直接合并。在语言和视觉领域的六个模型上的实验，包括三元化的LLaMA-3 1B和3B以及三元ViT-B/16，表明我们的方法恢复了量化导致的绝大部分性能损失。
tldr: 提出一种基于低秩Kronecker分解的三元乘法适配方法，可在不反量化的情况下直接微调三元Transformer权重，并显著恢复量化后的性能损失。
en_tdlr: We propose ternary multiplicative adaptation using low-rank Kronecker factorization to directly fine-tune ternary Transformer weights without dequantization, recovering most performance loss from quantization.
